description: Offline fallback inference rules for POST /api/ai/brand-inference (KDL-471 §4.4). First-match over lowercased industry keyword stems; the __default__ entry is mandatory. Typography resolves through the same pairing whitelist as the AI path (font-pairings.json). Tone content mirrors backend/src/modules/brand-kit/data/inference-rules.json v1 so both fallback layers agree. Strategy copy is template interpolation ({companyName}, {industry}, {hueName}) — honest boilerplate, clearly badged via source: 'fallback', never pretending to be inference. Built from first principles; the 5,561-line prototype does not exist (OQ-A CLOSED by CEO ruling on KDL-451, 2026-08-18).

tone.voice: Clear, precise, and forward-looking — communicates complexity with confidence and avoids jargon.

strategyTemplate.positioning: {companyName} builds dependable {industry} products that turn complex problems into clear, measurable outcomes. The brand leads with capability and proof rather than hype, anchored by a confident {hueName} palette.
strategyTemplate.audienceNotes: Primary audiences are technical evaluators and business decision-makers who value reliability, transparent documentation, and evidence of scale. Speak to their need to reduce risk while moving fast.
strategyTemplate.elevatorPitch: {companyName} delivers {industry} solutions that are precise, scalable, and built to earn trust from the first interaction.

tone.voice: Empathetic, trustworthy, and evidence-based — speaks to patients and professionals alike.

strategyTemplate.positioning: {companyName} provides {industry} services grounded in evidence and delivered with genuine care. The brand pairs clinical credibility with human warmth, reflected in a calm {hueName} palette.
strategyTemplate.audienceNotes: Audiences span patients, families, and healthcare professionals. Patients need reassurance and plain language; professionals need rigour and evidence. Every message should be readable by both without condescending to either.
strategyTemplate.elevatorPitch: {companyName} combines clinical expertise with genuine compassion, making quality {industry} care feel accessible and trustworthy.

tone.voice: Authoritative, transparent, and measured — projects stability and expertise without arrogance.

strategyTemplate.positioning: {companyName} offers {industry} expertise built on transparency and a proven track record. The brand projects stability and discretion, with a considered {hueName} palette signalling established confidence.
strategyTemplate.audienceNotes: Audiences are clients entrusting significant assets or decisions. They respond to precision, candour about risk, and visible expertise — and are repelled by hype, vagueness, or pressure tactics.
strategyTemplate.elevatorPitch: {companyName} brings clarity and proven judgement to {industry}, so clients can act with confidence.

tone.voice: Encouraging, accessible, and curious — makes learning feel achievable and exciting.

strategyTemplate.positioning: {companyName} makes {industry} feel achievable and genuinely exciting, meeting learners where they are and celebrating every step forward. A friendly {hueName} palette keeps the brand warm and unintimidating.
strategyTemplate.audienceNotes: Learners and the people who support them — students, parents, educators. They need encouragement without condescension, clear paths to progress, and proof that effort pays off.
strategyTemplate.elevatorPitch: {companyName} turns {industry} into a journey people actually want to be on — supportive, clear, and rewarding.

tone.voice: Vibrant, relatable, and aspirational — makes customers feel good about their choices.

strategyTemplate.positioning: {companyName} brings style and substance to {industry}, making every purchase feel like a good decision. The brand is vibrant and customer-first, with an expressive {hueName} palette that stands out on any shelf or screen.
strategyTemplate.audienceNotes: Everyday customers who want quality without pretension. They respond to warmth, clear value, and brands that celebrate them rather than the product. Keep sentences short and benefits up front.
strategyTemplate.elevatorPitch: {companyName} makes {industry} feel fresh, personal, and worth coming back for.

tone.voice: Warm, indulgent, and genuine — makes people hungry and welcome.

strategyTemplate.positioning: {companyName} serves {industry} experiences built on genuine craft and a warm welcome. The brand tells the story behind what it makes, with an inviting {hueName} palette that feels as good as it tastes.
strategyTemplate.audienceNotes: Guests choosing where to spend a meal, a celebration, or a quiet moment. They respond to sensory detail, authenticity, and hosts who clearly care. Atmosphere sells before the menu does.
strategyTemplate.elevatorPitch: {companyName} makes every {industry} moment feel personal, generous, and worth savouring.

tone.voice: Solid, expert, and delivery-focused — lets quality and track record speak.
donts: Don't use passive voice for outcomes

strategyTemplate.positioning: {companyName} delivers {industry} projects on time and built to last, letting a documented track record do the talking. A grounded {hueName} palette reinforces solidity and professional confidence.
strategyTemplate.audienceNotes: Clients and partners making high-stakes, long-horizon commitments. They want evidence of delivery, straight answers about scope and risk, and a partner who communicates in concrete terms.
strategyTemplate.elevatorPitch: {companyName} builds {industry} outcomes you can stand on: quantified, on schedule, and made to endure.

tone.voice: Precise, authoritative, and confidential — every word chosen with care.

strategyTemplate.positioning: {companyName} provides {industry} counsel where every word is chosen with care and every recommendation is defensible. The brand signals discretion and rigour, with a restrained {hueName} palette to match.
strategyTemplate.audienceNotes: Clients navigating consequential, often confidential matters. They value structured thinking, candour about complexity, and advisers who project calm authority without overpromising.
strategyTemplate.elevatorPitch: {companyName} brings precision and principled judgement to {industry}, protecting what matters most to clients.

tone.voice: Purposeful, human, and urgent — connects the cause to the reader's values.

strategyTemplate.positioning: {companyName} advances {industry} work that puts people and communities first, pairing urgency with hope. The brand leads with real impact and transparent outcomes, carried by a purposeful {hueName} palette.
strategyTemplate.audienceNotes: Supporters, volunteers, and the communities served. Donors need transparent evidence of impact; communities need dignity and agency in how they are represented. Shared values are the bridge.
strategyTemplate.elevatorPitch: {companyName} turns shared values into measurable {industry} impact — with the community, never just for it.

tone.voice: Professional, clear, and approachable — communicates value with confidence.

strategyTemplate.positioning: {companyName} delivers {industry} services with a focus on clarity, reliability, and results customers can see. The brand is professional without being distant, supported by a balanced {hueName} palette.
strategyTemplate.audienceNotes: Customers who want a competent, straightforward partner. They respond to plain language, visible proof of quality, and a brand that respects their time by getting to the point.
strategyTemplate.elevatorPitch: {companyName} makes {industry} simple: clear communication, dependable delivery, and results that speak for themselves.
